questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

The smoke rises and

A- chokes my apartment 

B- gets trapped in the 

C- tree-tops and
questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** 'BCA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• In the started sentence **'The smoke rises and'** it is ended with the verb **'rises'** and the **conjunction** is using **'and'** so that **'verb'** will come but in the sentence, C- **'tree-tops and'** is not started with the verb so it can be easily eliminated here.
 
• And B part **'gets trapped in the' **is suitable according to the **context **of the paragraph.
 
• The paragraph does not end with an article **'the'** or conjunction '**and'**. So, options 1, 2 & 4 are eliminated.

*Thus, **option 3 **is the correct answer.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

I (had been) a unique case of slow learning.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** 'No improvement'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

 
• There is **no improvement** is required in the given sentence in the question.
 
• In the first option, we know that **'has'** never be used with **'I', **we use **'have'** with it.
 
• In the second option, **'am'** is a helping verb of **continuous tense** so that need to put **V₁+ing **after it.
 
• In the third option, **'had'** is a helping verb of the **perfect tense** so that need to put **V₃** after it.
 
• Clearly, we can say there is no need for improvement in this sentence.

***The correct sentence is-** I **had been** a unique case of slow learning.*

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.**

The Queen was deeply affected, and said to the old woman, “What can I do for you?”

options.text: The Queen asked the old woman if she could do something for her.
The Queen was deeply affected and asked the old woman what she could do for her.
The Queen was deeply affected so she asked the old woman what her majesty could do for her.
The Queen asked the old woman if she could help her as she was deeply affected.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** 'The Queen was deeply affected and asked the old woman what she could do for her.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the question, **direct speech** is given and we need to change into** indirect speech.** Since a question is asked in **inverted commas** that too is in the present form of the **modal verb**.
 
• So, change **'can'** into a **past form** that is '**could'. **
 
• When a question is represented with **wh-word**, so conjunction **'if/whether'** is not used.

*Hence, **option 2 **is the** most appropriate** answer here.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Word **'majesty' **is not given in **direct speech**. So, there is no need of adding it in **indirect speech**.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

She handed him a bag.

options.text: A bag was hand to him.
A bag is handed by her.
A bag handed to him by her.
A bag was handed to him by her.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** ****'A bag was handed to him by her.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• In the given question the sentence **'She handed him a bag.'** is in **'Active voice'** which is in the** past indefinite** and we know that after **converted** this sentence into** 'Passive voice'** the tense will same which also should in **past indefinite**.
 
• **Past indefinite: **
 
 
• *Sub + V2 + object **(Active)***
 
• *Object + was/were + V3 + by + subject **(Passive)***
 
 
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• *Reema **cleaned** the floor **(Active)***
 
• *​The floor **was cleaned** by Reema **(Passive)***
 
 

***Hence the correct answer is-** A bag was handed to him by her. *

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence is given with blanks to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

We can never compare the importance ______ money with the importance of love.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** 'of'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• Using the preposition **'of'** in the black space of the given sentence will make a **meaningful **sentence.
 
• We know that **importance** will take the preposition **'of'** *(of - expressing the relationship between a part and a whole.) *after it. It is a kind of a **fixed proposition** here.
 
 
• ***Example: **I always dreamed **of **being famous.*
 
 

**Hence the correct sentence is-** We can never compare the **importance of** money with the importance of love.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's find the **uses** of the following **prepositions**:-** **

 
 
• **For-** *period of something; related to a reason. *
 
• **With-** *indicating responsibility.*
 
• **About-** *on the subject of; concerning. *

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

Experts have predict that (A)/ within ten years ethanol will emerge (B)/ as the primary automatic fuel in the world. (C)/ No error (D)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is**- 'error lies in the part-A'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

 
• Using **'predicted'** in place of **'predict'** to make the sentence **correct**.
 
• We know that **'have, has, had' **are the **helping verbs** of **perfect tense** and they always take the **third form** of the **verb(V₃).**
 
• **Structure of Present Perfect: ***Sub + has/have + V₃ + object*
 
 
• ***Example:** Ram **has gone** to market.*
 
 

***The correct sentence is- **Experts have **predicted** that within ten years ethanol will emerge as the primary automatic fuel in the world*.
